title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry
summary: We propose the first examples of scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry. They arise as circle compactifications of four-dimensional vacua of massive type IIA supergravity with scale separation, upon introducing additional fluxes and sources. We provide both the ten-dimensional solutions and the three-dimensional effective descriptions in terms of Kähler potential and superpotential. The conformal dimensions of the putative dual two-dimensional field theory appear not to be integers.
